title: fix(app-shell): the app-missing screen says what the probe measured (objectui#9262)
body:
Fixes #9262

Implements the ruled route B (decision batch #132 item 3, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-13):
the by-name app probe distinguishes the answers the transport already gives, and the
screen above it states only what it measured.

## Ruling item 3 first — cause 8, measured on a real server BEFORE the branches landed

Rig: real ObjectStack server, showcase example, `objectstack` commit `60b9955`,
`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4262`, API 17.4.0. Real `ObjectStackAdapter` over
the real `@objectstack/client@17.4.0` — the version this repo depends on. Nothing stubbed.

```
LIST (filterAppForUser, this session): ["showcase_app","setup","account"]
PROBE showcase_app     verdict=granted   inList=true  httpStatus=200  CAUSE-8 SHAPE: no
PROBE no_such_app_xyz  verdict=granted   inList=false httpStatus=200  CAUSE-8 SHAPE: YES
PROBE zzz_typo_9262    verdict=granted   inList=false httpStatus=200  CAUSE-8 SHAPE: YES
PROBE finance          verdict=granted   inList=false httpStatus=200  CAUSE-8 SHAPE: YES
```

**Cause 8 is not structural. It is the ordinary case, and the card's premise for causes
1/2/3 is falsified.** The card says an absent app "answers 404, which `probeAppAccess` maps
to `unknown`". It does not. `GET /api/v1/meta/app/NAME` for a name that does not exist
answers **200** carrying the declared envelope MINUS its `item` member:

```
GET /api/v1/meta/app/no_such_app_xyz
200 {"type":"app","name":"no_such_app_xyz","lock":"none","editable":true,"deletable":true,"resettable":false}
```

`probeAppAccess` returned `granted` whenever the call did not throw, so it reported
`granted` for an app with nothing behind it. Mechanism, read off `rest-server.ts`: the 403
`PERMISSION_DENIED` and the 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` both sit inside
`if (isAppType && visible)`, and `visible` is the document — for a name that resolves to
nothing the whole gate is skipped and the envelope falls through to `res.json`. The 404
branch is reachable only for an app that EXISTS and is withheld for a non-permission
reason.

Consequence for the design, and why the ruling ordered this measured first: a `not_found`
branch keyed on the 404 alone would have been **dead** for every typo, every never-created
app and every unpublished draft. Those absences would have kept falling through to the
neutral screen, and the PR would have read as green. Absence is therefore read from the
**envelope** as well as from the code. This is exactly "the shape the new branches would
otherwise miss".

Error shapes measured for the not-found / unreachable split:

| case | wire | verdict before | verdict now |
|---|---|---|---|
| app served | 200 + envelope `item` | granted | granted |
| absent, live server | 200, envelope without `item` | **granted** | **not_found** |
| absent, 404 dialect | code `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | unknown | not_found |
| permission refusal | code `PERMISSION_DENIED` | denied | denied |
| 5xx | code `INTERNAL_ERROR`, 500 | unknown | unreachable |
| offline | TypeError, no code | unknown | unreachable |

## Clause-② — the two members that widened the published contract

The published `ObjectStackDataSource.probeAppAccess` contract widens by exactly two
members, named by the ruling itself:

- **`not_found`** — the route answered, and the answer is that it has no app at this name
  for this session.
- **`unreachable`** — no answer was obtained at all.

`AppAccessVerdict` goes from `granted | denied | unknown` to
`granted | denied | not_found | unreachable | unknown`. `unknown` is narrowed rather than
widened: it now means only that nothing was asked (a host DataSource without this probe —
cause 5), so a consumer that read `unknown` as a positive absence must move to `not_found`.
The card carries `needs:contract-review` for this.

## Copy by verdict

- `not_found` — "This app can't be opened", no cause asserted, Retry.
- `unreachable` — "Couldn't reach the server", Retry.
- `denied` — unchanged from objectui#4252, still no Retry (no retry moves a permission
  decision).
- `unknown` — the neutral screen, which asserts nothing.
- `granted` reaching this branch is cause 8 itself: the route served the app while the
  refreshed list still lacks it. The console has no document to render and no account of
  the disagreement, so it takes the neutral screen. Naming an absence there would
  contradict the answer just received.

"it may still be publishing" is retired from all ten locale packs. A genuine post-publish
lag reads as `not_found`, and the one forced `refreshMetadata()` that gives that lag its
chance to resolve is untouched.

The enumeration surface the 2026-08-12 ruling guarded is not widened: the control plane
still answers the same way for every app the caller may not see, and this PR reads nothing
new off the list.

## Locale count — ten, as ruled

Verified against the pack layout: `ar de en es fr ja ko pt ru zh`. Ten, matching the
ruling's word.

## Tests

- `packages/data-objectstack/src/appAccessProbe.test.ts` — 17 pass. New: the measured
  item-less 200, an explicit `item: null`, the 5xx and the code-less 404 as `unreachable`,
  and the `isMetaItemAbsentError` predicate with its crossing controls.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx` —
  rewritten, not deleted, 14 pass. Its four "MUST NOT CHANGE — keeps the publishing copy"
  cases were correct when written and are now per-verdict screens; added THE MEASURED
  SHAPE (item-less 200) and CAUSE 8 (route serves the app, list does not carry it). A new
  case scans all ten packs for a per-language "publish" stem, because the call site's
  inline default is only reached when a pack MISSES the key — rewriting the component
  while a pack still carried the sentence would have left that language telling users
  about a publish with every other case green.
- Whole console suite `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/` — 19 files, 150 pass.
- `packages/i18n/` + `packages/data-objectstack/` — 132 files, 2009 pass.
- `type-check` green on all three packages (objectui spells it with the hyphen), after
  building the app-shell dependency closure so the consumer reads the rebuilt declaration
  rather than a stale one.

Two i18n pins moved with the sentence rather than around it, both documented in place:
`residue-namespaces-3546` (the fr and ru habit assertions read off the retired clause; the
ru `ё` is pinned on the sibling value that now carries it, in `учётной записи`) and
`ar-participle-orthography-6610`, whose `YA_IS_CORRECT` row for this key pinned the
accusative participle inside the publishing clause. That row is removed with a note saying
the orthography rule did not change and the value must not be edited back to restore it.

## Out of scope — filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#18066, not changed here

The server behaviour above diverges from what `objectstack` itself declares.
`GetMetaItemResponseSchema` declares `item` a REQUIRED member, and
`packages/rest/src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts` pins "the real producer miss is still the
404 it has always been" using a fixture whose `getMetaItem` REJECTS. The live objectql
provider resolves an envelope without `item` instead. This console handles both dialects,
so nothing here depends on that being decided.
